hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.NetworkEndpointS.description: NetworkEndpointSpec is which network reaches which service.

network.description: Names the Network in the endpoint's project whose machines reach the service; the endpoint's address is of its range. Deleting the network deletes its endpoints.

service.description: Names the EndpointService in the endpoint's project it reaches. A service that does not exist yet is waited for.

hangar.network.v1alpha1.NetworkEndpointS.description: NetworkEndpointStatus is where the network reaches the service.

hostname.description: The name the network's resolver answers with the address, such as "git.demo.hangar.internal": the endpoint's own name in the project's internal domain. A machine of the same name on the network keeps the name, and the endpoint is reached at its address alone.

ipv4.description: The endpoint's address, such as "10.0.0.7", the lowest one of the network's range no machine or other endpoint holds, given when the network exists and kept until the endpoint is deleted.

node.description: The Node that forwards the endpoint's traffic, its service's, kept when the service goes. A deleted NetworkEndpoint keeps its address until that node no longer holds it.

port.description: The port the service is reached at, its spec.port.

description: NetworkEndpoint is a network's way to an EndpointService of its project, as an AWS VPC interface endpoint is: an address of the network's own range, and a name its resolver answers, where the network's machines reach the service's port. The service's network is neither joined nor routed to, so the two networks' ranges may overlap. See docs/decisions/endpoint-services.md.
title: NetworkEndpoint
